_comment: Cards that exist only for the cast-from-exile condition test (tests/unit/casting/test_cast_from_exile.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_exile_blessing` is Ultimate Magic: Holy's shape on a life-gain body: a foretell sorcery whose rider branches on `cast_from_exile`, so a cast from hand gains 1 and a foretold cast gains 5.

cards.name: Test Exile Blessing
cards.oracle_text:
You gain 1 life. If this spell was cast from exile, you gain 4 life.
Foretell {W} (During your turn, you may pay {2} and exile this card from your hand face down. Cast it on a later turn for its foretell cost.)
